body.name: Single-hazard inclusion-minimal sufficient design frontier
body.construction:
For the single-informative-hazard graph, define
\[
\mathfrak F_1(T,k,j,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)
=\{B:\mathsf C_1(T,k,j,B,(|\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=1,\ 
\mathsf C_1(T,k,j,B',( |\mathcal X_t|)_{t=1}^T)=0
\text{ for every }B'\lneq B\},
\]
where \(B'\le B\) means \(B'_d\subseteq B_d\) for every \(d<T\).
